chapter: Los Angeles 1947-48, Rock Island and bebop in New York
title: Studying piano, theory and harmony at City College
summary: He studied piano, solfeggio and harmony until his grandmother's stroke ended his piano lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Later years, well, something to do, well, you know.
I'm smiling because I was there then.
Eric Dolphy I was there then too.
-- Yeah. I took up City College, it was junior college then. I took up piano and solfeggio and harmony and theory. Well I'd had harmony and theory in

high school but I was taking a brush up course on it, you know. But I really wanted to play the piano and I couldn't continue my piano lessons because my grandmother had a stroke and we had to bring her down to my house. My mother's house, rather. And she couldn't stand to hear the piano. So I had to give up the piano. I was renting a piano from Mannings, big red piano that used to be there on the corner of Western and Venice, I had to give up the piano.
